entries.subject: DAMIT 1804: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1804, version 2017-06-19, pole (123°, 46°), period 24.14011 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 100 ± 4 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model. DAMIT marks model 1804 as size-calibrated (D = 100 km, σ = 4 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 97 ± 4 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 27 light curves, 7 adaptive-optics images and 1 occultation (Table 3).
